goal: Connect the supplied product to a selected subscription with model reuse, separately approved model bootstrap, or cost-only in a 30-minute local-first solution; default to no cloud writes and no unapproved spend.
precedence: The solution contract's fixed-artifact mode, approvals, and acceptance criteria supersede older skeleton, init/scaffold, dashboard regeneration, frontend-last, mandatory-model, and automatic deployment behavior. Never regenerate a missing bundle.
receipt_policy: Reuse the bundle-declared local smoke receipt or session summary. Legacy .artifacts/deploy receipt paths below are optional hosted evidence, not a requirement to create solution scripts or certify deployment.

clock.starts: At the guided opening, including the one doctor pass.
clock.stops: When the supplied local smoke, MTD parity, and approved grounded answer or accepted cost-only outcome are reported; unfinished outcomes remain blocked or degraded.
clock.reporting: Record active time, external waits, total elapsed time, and target miss reasons in the supplied local result or session summary; no extra timing script. New resources, role propagation, and external provisioning or capacity waits cannot be guaranteed within 30 minutes.

prerequisite_bootstrap.local_override: Packaged launch requires only .NET 10 ASP.NET Core Runtime and Azure CLI, not Node/npm or the .NET SDK; older source-build, deployment, and evaluator tool requirements do not apply.
required_capabilities: .NET 10 ASP.NET Core Runtime for the supplied compiled app/frontend
Azure CLI authentication when user-authorized reads begin
supplied compiled app/frontend, source, and Bicep archives verified against bundle hashes and the matching producer receipt; user portal parity is separate
prerequisite_bootstrap.on_path_change: Restart the shell once, preserve completed checks, and run the exact resume command.
prerequisite_bootstrap.on_elevation_required: Stop and print one exact operator command plus one exact resume command; never attempt interactive elevation.

phase_budgets.required_outcome: Target and existing work are confirmed; tools are checked once; the user selects an enabled subscription, declares grant authority, and chooses model reuse, deployment in an approved existing resource, resource/project and model creation if none exists, or cost-only; model authentication is selected separately.

The verified bundle and matching receipt are consumed unchanged; only declared settings connect the existing .NET API and supplied frontend on loopback with explicit live mode and no automatic startup refresh.

One bounded MTD refresh verifies actual Cost Management, Advisor Cost, and Resource Graph capabilities without duplicate preflight fetches; portal comparison uses identical dates, billed ActualCost, currency, and collection time.
One supplied local smoke and at most one explicitly approved grounded model response pass, or the user accepts cost-only with ACO activation false; exact blockers and timing are reported.

authoritative_for: local stage before any separately approved hosting
outcomes_only: guide target, explicit subscription, declared authority, and model lifecycle selection separately from the three model authentication choices
connect supplied backend, frontend, and infrastructure artifacts without regenerating code
verify one MTD refresh and user portal parity with truthful source provenance
smoke the local product and an approved grounded ACO response or explicit cost-only outcome
minimum_product_surface: POST /api/v1/agent/responses/stream when the selected model capability is available and approved
demo_fast_path.model_bootstrap_policy: Follow spec/local-demo-delivery-contract.v1.json#user_flow/model_lifecycle_selection using current Microsoft Foundry skills/tools for approved region, model/deployment support, quota, and capacity discovery. Present exact resources, roles/principals/scopes, costs, capacity, and resource/grant expiry before explicit bootstrap/grant approval; honor matching current-run approval. Model bootstrap is the only local cloud-write exception with its approved grants, never app hosting, databases, or backend/frontend scaffolding.
defer_until_after_demo: application hosting, database provisioning, remote builds, and grants unrelated to separately approved model bootstrap
provider adapter implementation and package relocation
Cosmos DB and Blob persistence when in-memory or local encrypted cache is sufficient
performance tuning without a measured blocker
demo_fast_path.review_policy: Optional focused review only; reuse producer and solution evidence without new scripts, broad browser checks, or a mandatory certification loop.
demo_fast_path.tuner_policy: Do not invoke ACO Tuner during demo assembly; invoke only for a measured blocker or explicit user request.
demo_fast_path.coverage_policy: Use local solution acceptance, not the full ACI ledger or supplied product acceptance suite; broader coverage is a separate later milestone.
demo_fast_path.stop_policy: Continue independent authorized local work until acceptance or an exact external blocker. Do not enter hosting, regenerate code, repeat provider checks, or reset budgets to avoid reporting a blocker.

azure_liveliness_gate.trigger: After the guided opening and verified bundle configuration, use the one user-authorized MTD refresh as the source capability check; do not collect twice.
required_checks: Azure CLI authentication status is verified from structured output
subscription and tenant are selected explicitly
the selected Cost source, default Query or separately chosen Cost Details, returns authorized evidence; an authorized complete empty result is valid evidence
Advisor Cost recommendations return an authorized response; zero findings is valid evidence
Resource Graph returns an authorized inventory response
403 denial blocks the affected source; Cost Management 429 records quota metadata and enters deferred-throttled without stopping independent work

authentication.when_not_authenticated: Run Azure CLI interactive browser authentication; use device-code authentication only when browser launch is unavailable.
authentication.subscription_filter: Enabled only; show names and masked IDs to the user.
authentication.zero_enabled_subscriptions: Stop with one precise permission or tenant recovery message.
authentication.one_enabled_subscription: Ask the user to select it explicitly, then verify tenant and state.
authentication.multiple_enabled_subscriptions: Ask once for an explicit selection, showing names and masked identifiers only.
authentication.selection_policy: Pass the selected subscription explicitly to applicable management operations; bind the selected tenant and endpoint in data-plane adapters.
authentication.record_full_identifiers: Ignored local receipt only; never chat output or shared logs.

outcomes.passed: Azure account, Advisor, Resource Graph, and Cost Management are authorized; Cost Management returned live data or an authorized empty result.
outcomes.deferred_throttled: Azure account, Advisor, and Resource Graph are authorized while Cost Management returned 429 with safe retry metadata; independent work continues.
outcomes.blocked: Record the exact denied or failed capability. A 403 does not authorize a grant; continue already-authorized independent work without claiming complete live evidence.

cost_management_throttle_recovery.retry_policy: No automatic retry in the solution. Record the longest supplied retry-after deadline; a later attempt requires a new explicit refresh request after that deadline, with its own bounded budget.
cost_management_throttle_recovery.prework: A separately obtained user-authorized snapshot may be reused; do not run an extra warmup refresh or hide provider calls before the solution clock.
real_data_fallback_order: exact-scope validated authorized snapshot less than 24 hours old
cost_management_throttle_recovery.cost_details_recovery: The supplied launcher supports the separately user-selected -CostSource cost-details fallback. For that explicit collection, replace Query with one generation POST, never blindly retry it, then use supplied bounded polling and Retry-After handling. Never start automatically on Query 429; default Query has zero retries. Newly collected Cost Details must have its own live-source provenance and collection time.
cost_management_throttle_recovery.portal_import: Not implemented by the current bundle; do not promise ready portal CSV/FOCUS ingestion. User portal/export comparison remains manual and separate from collection.
continue_independent_work: verify supplied bundle paths, hashes, and producer receipt
connect already-approved declared settings without changing source
use supplied local checks against authorized evidence without new provider calls
prepare the user portal comparison or report exact blockers

aco_foundry_activation_gate.topology: supplied local Microsoft Agent Framework ACO supervisor connected through the verified adapter to the user's chosen reused or newly provisioned deployment
aco_foundry_activation_gate.tool_inventory_source: the verified product bundle; preserve the eight shipped read-only tools rather than registering replacements
aco_foundry_activation_gate.credential: Verified selected-tenant Azure identity, or protected process-scoped API-key input only for the supported Azure OpenAI key adapter; never infer model access from subscription Owner.
aco_foundry_activation_gate.unavailable_unsupported_denied_or_unappr: Offer cost-only with ACO activation false, or an explicit lifecycle choice for separately approved bootstrap; never provision automatically or implement an adapter. Bootstrap approval alone does not approve paid inference.
activation_success: the reused or newly provisioned deployment selected by the user is actually reachable through the shipped adapter; provisioning success or Owner is not inference access
one explicitly approved bounded model smoke completes without a separate invocation preflight
every numeric claim resolves to an evidence ID from the live revision
no raw billing rows, credentials, or cross-scope evidence enter the model context
model, prompt, tool-schema, live-revision, response, and trace hashes are recorded

prohibited_during_assembly: performance tuning beyond a failed threshold
frontend_stop_rule.on_verified_receipt: Do not inspect or modify frontend source or repeat shipped build/browser validation. Connect declared settings and continue the local solution.
frontend_stop_rule.on_failure: Repair only allowed configuration inputs and rerun the affected supplied check without another provider refresh. Report source or artifact defects to the producer; do not regenerate code.

allowed: target, explicit subscription, declared authority, and provider selection
model lifecycle selection, exact bootstrap/grant approval, and external resource or capacity waits
missing bundle, receipt, runtime capability, or permission
explicit bounded model-spend approval or accepted cost-only
secret entered directly by the operator
separately requested hosting approval or destructive what-if
not_allowed: unrelated cost estimation; required model-bootstrap cost, capacity, and expiry disclosure remains mandatory
sample-only success being presented as live user evidence
stopping solely because Cost Management returned a receipted 429 while Advisor and Resource Graph are authorized

optional_hosting.approval_scope: Each permission grant, app registration, provision, remote build, deployment, or spend needs explicit action, target principal/scope or resource, and cost-bound approval before execution.
optional_hosting.infrastructure: Reuse verified supplied Bicep and inputs; review non-destructive what-if before any approved deployment. Do not require or install Docker.
optional_hosting.channels: Supplied frontend by default; Inspector requires a verified compatible protocol adapter. Teams through Microsoft 365 Agents Toolkit is a separate optional later milestone, not an automatic supported deployment.
